actions.name: Disclose a LEZ public account for multi-witness transactions
actions.summary: Each member derives a public account from their own key and discloses it into the room. Nothing is registered on chain; a transaction's witness set is simply the accounts it names. Signers cannot change: a rotated key is a new account, and funds move with a transfer.

fields.name: publicKey
fields.means: the member's x-only secp256k1 public key

fields.name: zone
fields.means: the LEZ network the member uses it on (room binding only; the chain's bytes carry none)

agreement.threshold: each member discloses their own account
agreement.domain: a room disclosure entry; nothing is signed for the chain

steps.does: derives the account id from its key and discloses it (S1); readers check the account against the sequencer RPC and the room shows whether they agree
steps.signs: a room log entry under the member's authorization key; nothing on chain

reveals.field: account nonce and balance reads (sequencer RPC)

refusals.what: a disclosed account id that is not SHA256 of the prefix and the disclosed public key
refusals.why: invariant 1: the room re-derives the account from the key before anyone relies on it

refusals.what: a proposal to change an account's signer
refusals.why: the account id is derived from one key; membership is fixed, so the room offers a transfer to a new account instead

claims.claim: The account id is derived from the key; nothing is registered on chain.
An account's signer can never change; rotating a key means a new account.
The account, its balance and its nonce are public on the zone once used.

evidence.what: AccountId = SHA256("/LEE/v0.3/AccountId/Public/" padded to 32 || x-only public key)
Nonce(u128) and ProgramShardSelector {account_id, program_account_id}
a missing account's nonce reads as the default (0)

unverified: The registry's sources point at the repo's `main` branch (stale, 2026-08-07); the Message shape it records matches the default branch `dev` (commit f7fda38a, 2026-09-26), which these sources pin.

actions.name: Send native LEZ with a co-signing fee payer
actions.summary: A member sends the native token from their public account; when another member pays the fee, both sign the same message. Every listed witness must sign.

fields.name: recipient
fields.means: the receiving account; it does not sign

fields.name: feePayer
fields.means: the account debited for the fee (a witness; may be the sender)

fields.name: maxFee
fields.means: the most the payer will pay

fields.name: nonces
fields.means: each witness's current nonce, read from the zone, in witness order

fields.name: program
fields.means: the native token program (account id all zeros); shard selectors pick each account's native-balance shard

agreement.threshold: all n listed witnesses (the sender, plus the fee payer when it is another account)
agreement.domain: SHA256("/LEE/v0.3/Message/Public/" padded to 32 || borsh(Message)); no zone id

disclosure.field: witness account nonce and balance reads
every witness's public key and signature (who signed)

steps.does: composes the transfer and fee declaration; reads each witness's nonce through the sequencer RPC (external reads); the room builds the Message and re-derives its hash
each witness (the sender; the fee payer if different) re-derives the message hash and signs it
steps.signs: BIP-340 Schnorr (secp256k1, prehashed, fresh aux randomness) over the 32-byte digest SHA256(PREFIX || borsh(Message)), PREFIX = "/LEE/v0.3/Message/Public/" padded with zero bytes to 32; borsh(Message) encodes, in order, program_account_id (32 bytes), shard_selectors (each an (account_id, program_account_id) pair), nonces (one u128 per witness, in witness order), instruction_data, and fee (none, or payer, gas_limit, tip, max_fee). No chain or zone id is in these bytes. One 64-byte signature and the signer's x-only public key per witness

steps.does: one member submits the transaction to the sequencer RPC; the sequencer checks one nonce per witness, no duplicate signers, every signature valid over the message hash, each nonce equal to that account's current nonce, and the fee payer's signature; it then executes the program with the witnesses as the authorized accounts and advances every witness's nonce
steps.signs: nothing new; the member assembles PublicTransaction {message, witness_set: [(signature, public_key) …]} with the witnesses in the same order as the nonces and submits it to the sequencer

reveals.field: every witness's public key and signature (who signed)

steps.does: watches the transaction's inclusion and the zone's finality through the sequencer RPC

refusals.what: a witness signature over a digest other than the one the room re-derives from the effect
submitting to a sequencer whose zone differs from the disclosed account's environment
refusals.why: invariant 2: the chain's bytes name no zone, so only muster's envelope binds the transaction to one network; the chain would not catch it

refusals.what: a stale nonce: any witness account's nonce moved since the proposal (re-read at review and at settle)
refusals.why: invariant 10: each nonce is an external read in the signed bytes; the sequencer rejects "Nonce mismatch" and every collected witness is void

refusals.what: the same account twice in the witness set, or nonces not in witness order
refusals.why: the sequencer rejects duplicate signers and pairs nonces with witnesses by position; muster refuses before submitting

refusals.what: settling before every listed witness has signed
refusals.why: all of n: the sequencer rejects the whole transaction if any listed signature is missing or invalid; there is no threshold below n

refusals.what: a fee declaration whose payer has not signed
refusals.why: the payer is authorized only by its own witness signature, never inferred from the witness set

claims.claim: Every listed witness must sign; there is no k-of-n.
Each witness's nonce is checked and advanced, so a signed transaction settles at most once per nonce.
The signed bytes name no zone or network: the same transaction is valid on any LEZ network where each witness's nonce matches.
claims.party: whoever holds the signed transaction on another LEZ network (room members; the sequencer RPC)

claims.claim: Any other transaction from any witness account first makes every collected witness stale.
The sequencer RPC sees the whole signed transaction before inclusion.
The sequencer can delay or drop the transaction.
Every witness's public key and signature is public once settled, so observers learn exactly who signed.
Witness signatures never expire; to cancel, spend one witness's nonce on another transaction.
The recipient does not sign and cannot block the transfer; the native program needs only the sender's authorization.

evidence.what: LEZ public Message {program_account_id, shard_selectors, nonces, instruction_data, fee}; hash = SHA256("/LEE/v0.3/Message/Public/" padded to 32 || borsh)
WitnessSet: (signature, public_key) pairs; is_valid_for requires every pair to verify over the message hash
authenticate_public_transaction_signers: nonce count = witness count, no duplicate signers, all signatures valid, each nonce = current
every witness account's nonce is incremented when the transaction applies
FeeDeclaration {payer, gas_limit, tip, max_fee} is covered by the message hash; the payer must sign
Signature: k256 BIP-340 Schnorr, sign_prehash_with_aux_rand / verify_prehash
AccountId = SHA256("/LEE/v0.3/AccountId/Public/" padded to 32 || x-only public key)
BIP-340: Schnorr signatures for secp256k1
native token program: Transfer {amount} over [sender, recipient]; only the sender must be authorized
the LEZ wallet's public native transfer: shard selectors for sender and recipient under NATIVE_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID

unverified: Whether the sequencer accepts a fee-exempt (fee: none) user transaction, or only system transactions.

actions.name: Call a LEZ program that needs several accounts to authorize
actions.summary: Several members sign one public transaction that calls a program over accounts each of them owns, such as an exchange between two members. The program sees every witness as authorized; every listed witness must sign.

fields.name: accounts
fields.means: the shard selectors: each (account, owning program) pair the call reads or writes

fields.name: witnesses
fields.means: the accounts that sign; the program treats them as authorized

fields.name: instruction
fields.means: the instruction data, decoded by the program's driver; shown as undeclared when no decoder exists

fields.name: nonces
fields.means: each witness's current nonce, in witness order

fields.name: fee
fields.means: the fee declaration (payer, gas_limit, tip, max_fee), or none

agreement.domain: SHA256("/LEE/v0.3/Message/Public/" padded to 32 || borsh(Message)); no zone id

disclosure.field: every witness's public key and signature (who signed)

steps.does: composes the call; reads that the program is deployed and each witness's nonce through the sequencer RPC; the room builds the Message and re-derives its hash
each listed witness re-derives the message hash, reviews the decoded instruction, and signs
steps.signs: BIP-340 Schnorr (secp256k1, prehashed, fresh aux randomness) over the 32-byte digest SHA256(PREFIX || borsh(Message)), PREFIX = "/LEE/v0.3/Message/Public/" padded with zero bytes to 32; borsh(Message) encodes, in order, program_account_id (32 bytes), shard_selectors (each an (account_id, program_account_id) pair), nonces (one u128 per witness, in witness order), instruction_data, and fee (none, or payer, gas_limit, tip, max_fee).
